cohort: 77 pregnant women of all ages who presented with snakebites to a treatment and research hospital in Northeastern Nigeria between 2019 and 2024.
finding: All pregnant women presenting with snakebites recovered from the snakebite envenoming.
mod_finding: Of two women who gave birth prior to discharge, one underwent spontaneous vaginal delivery followed by neonatal death, and one underwent caesarean section with survival of both mother and child.
